description_en: Principal field laboratory. UNESCO describes the Grand Canal (C 1443, 2014) in terms of transportation, political and economic integration and cultural interchange. The Beijing section is studied as a deep field laboratory within the larger canal system, with attention to canal-road, canal-river and canal-city interfaces. Evidence: UNESCO WHC C 1443 [A].
description_zh: 主要田野实验室。联合国教科文组织将大运河（编号C 1443，2014年列入）的描述聚焦于运输、政治经济整合和文化交流。北京段作为更大运河体系内的深层田野实验室被研究，特别关注运河-道路、运河-河流和运河-城市接口。来源：UNESCO WHC C 1443 [A]。

description_en: A principal Beijing site for investigating the chain water → urban life → food → markets → residence → memory → tourism. Questions include: What activities remain connected to water? What has been reinvented? Which routes remain socially meaningful? Who uses these spaces? Evidence: drafted research proposal [B]; historical and urban studies [B].
description_zh: 北京考察链条'水 → 城市生活 → 食物 → 市场 → 居住 → 记忆 → 旅游'的主要场所。问题包括：哪些活动仍然与水相连？什么被重新发明？哪些路线仍具有社会意义？谁在使用这些空间？来源：drafted 研究提案 [B]；历史与城市研究 [B]。

description_en: A second major Beijing field environment. The canal is explicitly implicated in contemporary urban development, public space, cultural programming and regeneration. Research question: What happens to a historical transportation corridor when it becomes an instrument of contemporary urban regeneration? Evidence: drafted research proposal [B].
description_zh: 北京第二个主要田野环境。运河明确参与了当代城市发展、公共空间、文化规划和城市更新。研究问题：当一条历史交通走廊成为当代城市更新的工具时，会发生什么？来源：drafted 研究提案 [B]。

description_en: Historically a canal gateway environment where goods transferred between water and land routes. Research question: What becomes visible when we follow movement rather than monuments? Evidence: drafted research proposal [B].
description_zh: 历史上河运与陆运货物转运的运河门户环境。研究问题：当我们追踪流动而非纪念碑时，什么变得可见了？来源：drafted 研究提案 [B]。

description_en: UNESCO World Heritage (Reference 731, 1995), described as 'the best-preserved fortified commercial city in northern Europe'. Main centre of the Hanseatic League in the Baltic from the 12th to 14th century. Provides the urban and maritime context for investigating historical connectivity, medieval identity, heritage, commerce, tourism and contemporary representations of the past. Evidence: UNESCO WHC 731 [A].
description_zh: UNESCO世界遗产（编号731，1995年列入），被描述为'北欧保存最完好的设防商业城市'。12至14世纪波罗的海汉萨同盟的主要中心。为考察历史连通性、中世纪身份认同、遗产、商业、旅游和当代过去再现提供城市和海洋语境。来源：UNESCO WHC 731 [A]。

description_en: Viking Age trading port on Gotland demonstrating long-distance connectivity, with imported materials from mainland Sweden, Italy, Poland/Lithuania and the Caucasus (Carlsson 1999; Peschel et al. 2017). Isotope evidence indicates ~85% of studied individuals were local (Peschel et al. 2017, Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports 13: 175-184). Ridanäs is NOT on the UNESCO Tentative List (Sweden's list holds one entry, 'The Rise of Systematic Biology', 2009) [A: whc.unesco.org].
description_zh: 哥特兰的维京时代贸易港，展示了远距离连通性——出土了来自瑞典大陆、意大利、波兰/立陶宛和高加索的进口材料（Carlsson 1999; Peschel et al. 2017）。同位素证据表明约85%的被研究个体为本地人（Peschel et al. 2017, J. Archaeological Science: Reports 13: 175–184）。Ridanäs 不在 UNESCO 暂定名录（瑞典暂定名录仅列一项 The Rise of Systematic Biology, 2009）[A: whc.unesco.org]。

description_en: Iron Age settlement (c. AD 400-550) within the UNESCO-listed Agricultural Landscape of Southern Öland (Reference 968, 2000). Excavations led by Ludvig Papmehl-Dufay (2019-ongoing) revealed a chieftain's estate with 19 house foundations, extensive food-preparation evidence and pig-bone assemblages associated with feasting (Papmehl-Dufay 2020-2025). Holtorf's chapter 'An Archaeology of Growth and Regeneration' (2022) connects this evidence to the past generating future life.
description_zh: 南厄兰岛UNESCO世界遗产农业景观（编号968，2000年）内的铁器时代聚落（约公元400–550年）。Ludvig Papmehl-Dufay主持的发掘（2019年至今）揭示了一处酋长庄园，含19处房屋基址、大量食物制备证据以及与宴饮实践相关的猪骨组合（Papmehl-Dufay 2020–2025）。Holtorf的章节《成长与再生的考古学》（2022）将此证据与'过去生成未来生命'相连接。

description_en: Completed 1871, historically connecting southern forest-producing areas with northern agricultural areas. Now survives partly through cultural and tourism functions and is designated a 'kulturhistoriskt värdefull miljö av riksintresse' (culturally valuable environment of national interest). Connects to the Göta Canal system via Lake Roxen (Nykvarn lock). Evidence: Linköpings kommun; kindakanal.se [B]; drafted research proposal [B].
description_zh: 1871年完工，历史上连接南部林业产区和北部农业区。现在部分依靠文化和旅游功能维持，并被指定为'具有国家利益的文化历史价值环境'。通过罗克森湖（Nykvarn船闸）连接到约塔运河体系。来源：Linköpings kommun; kindakanal.se [B]；drafted 研究提案 [B]。
